title: 30A 4BR/4.5BA Vacation Home with a Private Pool
meta_description: Khalee-SEA, a 4BR, 4.5BA vacation home on 30A with a private pool, a large open concept kitchen, an entertainment area, and Xplorie benefits. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: Come enjoy Khalee-sea, a large beach retreat with private pool, conveniently located just north of 30A in the heart of Seacrest, Florida! This striking 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath home in the Seabreeze community sleeps up to 12 guests. All 4 bedrooms offer private bathrooms.As you walk up the stairs to the main floor you're greeted by the large open concept kitchen and entertaining area. The kitchen island offers plenty of prep space as well as casual seating for 4. The more formal dining area has seating for 8 and there's a picnic-style table right outside on the balcony. Head down to the backyard and grill your favorites poolside. There's plenty of seating around the pool for both lounging and dining.This home is a short 3-minute walk to the beach access located less than 1 mile from the surrounding communities of Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Watersound. Seabreeze Trail puts you within a short walk, bike ride, or drive to fun family activities like The Big Chill (formerly The Hub), delicious restaurants, popular boutiques, and more!Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: Queen bed, TV. Private bathroom with shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: 2 sets of twin-over-full bunk beds, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: Queen bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, TV and private balcony. Private bathroom with shower.Beach Access:Head back out of the neighborhood via Seabreeze Trail. Directly across 30A is your beach access, Seabreeze.Distance: 600 feet | Time: 3 minutes walkingYour stay at Khalee-sea comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 4 cars.An initial starter kit of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
